description: Browse the Kosovo Agency of Statistics (ASKdata) PxWeb subject tree. Default path 'ASKdata' returns top-level folders (type 'l') and tables (type 't', '.px' suffix). Supply a deeper sub-path like 'ASKdata/Prices/Consumer Price Index' to drill into a subject area.

path.description: Sub-path (default "ASKdata" = top database). e.g. "ASKdata/Prices/Consumer Price Index".

name: subjects
